title: Approval
description: A permission prompt the PA chat is parked on (personal-assistant/src/chat/feed.js permissionPending): the dashboard's "Waiting for your yes" card and Talk's spoken question. Bound to one exact tool call by its tool_use id. The answer is $defs/decision (POST /api/chat/permission).

text.description: What the call does, one line (transcript.describeTool)

approvable.description: true only for the chat's own actions (CHAT_ACTION_TOOLS); anything else is answered in termhub

ask.description: The question spoken before the action runs (transcript.askTool); null unless approvable
